scope: Manual relative elastic comparison of the full pump cap cross-section, including body and leaves. This is not a printed-part force or durability qualification.

method.model: 2D linear plane stress; constant-strain triangular elements; self-balanced opposing unit hook loads; rigid-body motion constrained
method.elastic_modulus: Normalized to 1; no physical material modulus assigned
method.body_root_opening: Difference between transverse displacements at the two leaf/body junctions

limitations: Homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity; printing anisotropy and nonlinear displacement are not represented.
No pump contact, printed material strength, absolute force, temperature, fatigue or vibration result.
The new cap requires a physical fit and retention trial.
